title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Developer's Office Rocked By An Explosion
description: Rockstar North, the development studio behind Grand Theft Auto 6, was struck by an explosion earlier this week at its office in Edinburgh, Scotland. The explosion occurred at 5:02 AM local time on January 19, and it apparently took place in the facility's boiler room. According to BNO News, the incident set off a small fire at Rockstar North's office, and emergency response crews were on the scene for four hours. No injuries were reported from the fire or explosion, and Rockstar issued a statement that thanked the first responders and assured fans that GTA 6 development wasn't affected. "Many thanks to those that reached out with concern, and also to the police and fire crews who were on scene quickly to access the situation. Please know that everyone is well and our studio remains open and operational." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Life Is Strange: Reunion Finally Brings Back Chloe Price
description: Deck Nine and Square Enix have officially revealed Life is Strange: Reunion after a tease last week and an Xbox Wire leak earlier today. It's out in March and is meant to serve as the culmination and conclusion of Max Caulfield and Chloe Price's story. Yes, Chloe Price is returning in Life is Strange: Reunion after not appearing in 2024's Double Exposure, to the chagrin of the series' fan base. It'll follow the pair as they reunite following Max's merging of realities at the end of Double Exposure and Chloe's time either being dead or serving as a tour manager for a band called Drugstore Makeup. A fire is seemingly destined to destroy Caledon University, where Max has settled down. The key to preventing that (and some more cataclysmic events in the future) will force Max and Chloe to reunite and work together. The stream featuring the game's announcement trailer revealed more, like the fact that it will account for whether or not players decided to let Chloe die at the end of the original. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: What To Do First In Hytale
description: Hytale is out now in early access, and when you first spawn into a fresh world, you'll notice a few things. For starters, if you've ever seen or played Minecraft before, you'll feel like you're in a familiar place, as Hytale looks extremely similar. Not only that, but Hytale also follows an almost identical gameplay loop to Minecraft. You spawn into a randomly-generated map and must scavenge for resources around you to create equipment, a base, and advance your character. While Minecraft veterans might feel right at home with this sort of gameplay, other players could use a sense of direction. There are no quest markers, few NPCs to meet, or objects to point you towards a specific location. You can always figure things out for yourself, but if you need some guidance, check out the guide below that gives you some ideas on what to do first in Hytale. Table of Contents [hide]Where to go first in Hytale Where to go first in Hytale When you create a fresh world in Hytale and spawn in, you'll likely be asking yourself where to go rather than what to do. Well, with Hytale being a sandbox that has a randomly-generated map for every world, there's not one, specific answer to that question. Continue Reading at GameSpot

description: While Fortnite is known to feature partnerships with outside IP for its Battle Royale, Lego Odyssey, and Fortnite Festival modes, every so often the focus will shift to Fortnite Islands--the game's robust custom map scene. Today, two of the community's top creators, Chartis and Teravision Games, have announced the next custom map collaboration will be with Wizards of the Coast, as Dungeons & Dragons makes its Fortnite debut with five maps featuring five unique experiences. The five Dungeons & Dragons maps were created using Epic's UEFN engine, which contains tools within Unreal Engine specifically for creating new Fortnite experiences. title: Code Vein 2 Has A Spa, So The Apocalypse Can Wait
description: Anime-inspired souls-like Code Vein 2 is set in a grim world, and after a day of slaying Horrors--powerful beings corrupted by a mysterious entity known only as the Luna Rapacis--a dip in a hot spring alongside your Revenant Partner is naturally a welcome reprieve. Fortunately, you can do just that in the game, and that's something that Bandai Namco wants to remind prospective players with a new trailer featuring people in a classical spa while humanity teeters on the brink of collapse. No, talkative guy in the spa, I do not want to chat after spending a day time-traveling and risking my digital skin in a post-apocalyptic landscape. Code Vein 2's hot spring is part of the hub where players can prepare for missions, and it does serve a purpose in the game. Bandai Namco hasn't gotten into in-depth detail on it, but it has teased that your character might be struck with rare ideas for new item-synthesis recipes. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Marathon Might Be Part Of A Dying Breed Of Game, Former Art Director Says
description: Bungie's upcoming anticipated extraction shooter, Marathon, is scheduled to arrive in early March, and is, as of this writing, one of the highest-selling games over on Steam. Even with the alleged stolen-art controversy, it's looking like Marathon could be the winner that Bungie needs it to be after Concord failed to take off. According to former art director Joseph Cross, that level of commitment to an unproven IP might be a thing of the past soon. In an interview with ReaderGrev, Cross feels like the state of funding for games has reached a point where studios shouldn't blindly fund games based on spec and compares Concord to Marathon on the same sort of production scale. "Marathon is such a massive project. The studio took such a risk on this. You know, oftentimes we felt like we were sort of getting away with something," he said. "I think about that in the big picture, the idea of studios funding unproven, unknown projects for six or eight years, for hundreds of millions of dollars, sort of on spec. How much longer are things like this going to exist? I've been part of a couple of them now." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Switch 2 Will Get A Price Hike This Year, Expert Predicts
description: After Nintendo warned it might happen, one analyst is now predicting that the Nintendo Switch 2 will see a global price hike in 2026. Daniel Ahmad of Niko Partners said the Switch 2 will follow the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S with its own price hike this year, due in part to tariffs, increased memory costs, and "broader economic conditions." Ahmad said Nintendo stuck with the $450 price for the base model in 2025 despite the impact of tariffs in places like Vietnam, China, and Japan where Switch 2 units are produced. "More recently, increased demand for AI data centers has pushed RAM and storage prices up," Ahmad wrote. He further when on to predict that Nintendo could also opt to discontinue the $450 Switch 2 model and only sell the $500 edition that includes Mario Kart World. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Apparent Project Blackbird Footage Shows The ZeniMax Online MMO That Could Have Been
description: What is allegedly footage of ZeniMax Online Studio's canceled sci-fi MMO Project Blackbird is now out in the wild, giving a glimpse at what might have been had Microsoft not scrapped the project. The footage, shared by eXtas1stv on X and corroborated by Insider Gaming, is internal studio test footage meant to show off the game's lighting using Unreal Engine 4. The two-minute clip shows a cyberpunk city giving off strong Blade Runner energy--one filled with neon lights and various NPCs. Among them are what looks to be alien species, further highlighting the game's sci-fi setting. 👀🔥 LEAK ⚡️Nuevo metraje de "Project Blackbird", el MMO de Zenimax Online cancelado hace meses por Xbox.Qué ganas le tenía 🥺. pic.twitter.com/4Nz1G22l2F — eXtas1s 🎮 Noticias & Rumores (@eXtas1stv) January 18, 2026 According to Insider Gaming's Tom Henderson, the footage is from "years ago" and "nowhere near a representation of the game that was canceled." However, it does at least give curious fans a better idea of what ZeniMax Online was going for with the project. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Far Cry 3 And Other Series Classics Will Run At 60FPS After An Update
description: A trio of Far Cry games, headlined by Far Cry 3, is getting a frame rate boost on current-generation consoles with updates launching on January 21. Ubisoft posted cryptic hints implying that Far Cry 3 and spin-offs Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon and Far Cry Primal would receive 60fps patches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the French publisher has since confirmed this to be the case by showing off smooth gameplay footage of all three games in separate X posts. A once-in-a-lifetime vacation. 🌴Unspoiled nature. Open skies.Everything runs smoother at 60 FPS on current gen consoles. Pack light. Things escalate fast. #FarCry3 pic.twitter.com/WkhHp9paYF — Far Cry (@FarCrygame) January 18, 2026 Technically, Primal on Xbox One and the original Xbox 360 version of 3 already had 60fps support on Xbox Series X|S through the console's FPS Boost feature. Still, this is a noteworthy update for the "Classic Editions" of 3 and Blood Dragon on PS4 and Xbox One, along with Primal on PS4. Continue Reading at GameSpot
